description: This file defines the LdapConfigurationController class within the OrangeHRM project. It manages LDAP configuration settings in the admin plugin, extending a Vue.js-based abstract controller and utilizing services to fetch LDAP settings, which influence the rendering of LDAP configuration UI components.

classes.name: LdapConfigurationController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling LDAP configuration in the admin interface, generating Vue components with LDAP settings visibility based on LDAP 'enable' status.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the LDAP configuration component for rendering, setting properties based on LDAP settings retrieved via service.
